title: Blob Royale protocol v2 world snapshot data
description: One complete immutable simulation tick: every published entity in ascending entity_id order with the components it carries, plus the generic match section. Never a delta, never partial.

entities.$comment: Every published entity counts against this bound, including map static bodies and the zone entity. Ascending unique entity_id is a normative invariant that JSON Schema cannot express; docs/protocol/v2.md owns it and C++ conformance tests assert it.
